description.mekanism.crusher: A machine used to crush ingots into their dust counterparts, as well as perform many other operations.
description.mekanism.energized_smelter: A simple machine that serves as a Mekanism-based furnace that runs off of energy.
description.mekanism.enrichment_chamber: A simple machine used to enrich ores into two of their dust counterparts, as well as perform many other operations.
description.mekanism.metallurgic_infuser: A machine used to infuse various materials into (generally) metals to create metal alloys and other compounds.
